name: Safari-like Zen · Glass
description: Experimental fork of Safari-like Zen: the pinned sidebar panel is a native macOS 26 Liquid Glass (NSGlassEffectView) behind Zen's own sidebar UI, plus everything the original does: native window corners, Safari-matched padding, site colour, spring motion.
author: prewue

window-radius.uc.mjs.name: Startup script
window-radius.uc.mjs.description: Applies the native macOS window corner radius and removes the content separation.

page-canvas.uc.mjs.name: Page canvas colour
page-canvas.uc.mjs.description: Samples the current page's background colour so the gap around the pinned sidebar panel reads as page rather than as the workspace gradient.

site-accent.uc.mjs.name: Site accent colour
site-accent.uc.mjs.description: Takes the current site's accent colour from its favicon, its theme-color or its canvas, and gives it to the sidebar.

folder-motion.uc.mjs.name: Folder motion
folder-motion.uc.mjs.description: Retimes folder animations so icon, chevron and content move together, and publishes space swipe progress so the blur can follow the gesture.

native-glass.uc.mjs.name: Native glass
native-glass.uc.mjs.description: Puts a native macOS 26 Liquid Glass (NSGlassEffectView) behind the pinned sidebar panel, through native/SafariZenGlass.dylib.
